messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Different number of rows between the original methylation result file and the read in methylRaw object?
parts:
read function doesn't filter rows, I would make  sure that the step that you lose CpGs are really the read() step and not unite(). If it is the read() step, please send a reproducible example

Best,
Altuna

On Wed, Dec 2, 2015 at 10:17 PM, <cafelu...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi all,

I used the read function to read in a list of methylation result files and was able to do differential methylation analysis, and other stats. However, I was just checking the results and found that there is a huge difference between the number of rows in the methylRaw object and the number of rows from the original file. Am I missing anything here? or is this expected?

My read function arguments are like this:

methyl_obj <- read(<list of files>,
                   sample.id=<list of sample ids>,
                   assembly="hg19",
                   header=TRUE,
                   context="CpG",
                   resolution="base",
                   pipeline=list(fraction=TRUE,chr.col=1,start.col=2,end.col=3,
                                 coverage.col=6,strand.col=4,freqC.col=5 ),
                   ) 


thanks!!
